items.question: Which program should I choose?
items.answer: Choose based on the skills you want to add. Advanced focuses on AI and marketing; Professional adds communication; Master adds creative media; Diploma combines both.

items.question: Can I see the full syllabus?
items.answer: Yes. Open the curriculum page for each program to review the learning areas in more detail.

items.question: Are internships included for every learner?
items.answer: Internship opportunities are subject to eligibility, selection and availability. Confirm current terms with the academy before enrolling.

items.question: Can I ask about fees and schedules?
items.answer: Yes. Contact the team for current fees, upcoming batches and delivery details.

sections.heading: Big goals? Start with a conversation.
sections.description: Ask about curriculum, fees, internship eligibility and upcoming batches. Our team will help you find your fit.
